# Repository settings

Applied with `gh repo edit` or through Settings on github.com.

**Description**

> AlphaZero-style chess engine written from scratch in Python: bitboard move
> generation verified by perft, a hand-written reverse-mode autograd engine,
> and batched PUCT search. NumPy is the only dependency.

**Topics**

`chess` `chess-engine` `alphazero` `reinforcement-learning` `mcts`
`monte-carlo-tree-search` `deep-learning` `neural-network` `numpy`
`from-scratch` `autograd` `self-play` `bitboard` `uci` `python`

**Settings worth turning on**

- Issues: on (the roadmap in docs/results.md lists real next steps)
- Wiki, Projects, Discussions: off — the documentation lives in `docs/`
- "Automatically delete head branches": on
- Branch protection on `main`: require the CI workflow to pass
